title: Daily Temperatures
problem: An agricultural greenhouse has a series of future daily temperature forecasts `temperatures`. The administrator wants to know after each day how many days they must wait until a higher temperature occurs, in order to schedule automatic ventilation and shading strategies. If there is no future day with a higher temperature, the value for that position is 0.
strategy: Maintain a monotonic decreasing stack of indices storing temperatures. When encountering a higher temperature, pop the stack and write the answer.
learning_objectives: Understand that the temperature values corresponding to the indices stored in the monotonic stack remain strictly decreasing, and be able to verify this state invariant through a trace.
Based on the current temperature and the temperature at the stack top, predict whether the next step is to pop the stack and write the answer or to push the current index.
Given an input `temperatures` array, manually simulate the pop order and write the final values of the `answer` array.
